PM Modi Gifts Indian Handicrafts to Seychelles Leaders

During a visit to Seychelles, Prime Minister Narendra Modi presented gifts to local leaders. The presents included Kanchivaram silk, Maheshwari stole, a brass tortoise, and a Toda shawl, highlighting Indian craftsmanship. These gifts were part of diplomatic exchanges during the visit.
